summary: Verified Electron auto-update friendly-error fix via node unit tests + static review + web smoke. All original tests pass; additional 6 assertions (a-f) pass; YAML workflow valid; package.json/build/README confirmed; web app login/dashboard/rokad OK.
critical_code_review_comments: update-messages.js is a pure module (no electron import) — correct, enables plain-node unit testing.

updater.js: autoUpdater 'error' handler and portable catch both route through showUpdateProblem → friendlyUpdateError; no raw err.message leaks to dialog. setFeedURL driven by resolveFeed(cfg).feed; electron-log warns on mode==='private-missing-token'. Looks good.
resolveFeed uses token whenever present even if CI's `private` flag is false — matches requirement.
friendlyUpdateError(null, {}) returns empty string (first line of ''). Non-throwing as required; message is empty, which is acceptable but could be improved to a generic fallback for robustness.

Workflow writes owner/repo/repoPrivate/private/token and emits ::warning when repo is private and UPDATE_TOKEN secret is empty. Build step passes --config.publish.owner/--config.publish.repo. permissions: contents: write present.
package.json build.publish: provider=github, releaseType=release; win targets include nsis, portable, zip. All as required.
README section 'Auto-update ke liye repo setting' documents both Option A (public) and Option B (fine-grained PAT, Contents: Read-only, UPDATE_TOKEN secret, rebuild & reinstall Setup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Electron GUI cannot be launched here; verification is node-level + static. Original test script path: electron/scripts/test_update_messages.js. Added extra assertions at electron/scripts/test_update_messages_extra.js. Web app smoke: login + /rokad works via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: Previous 404 dialog was raw electron-updater HttpError including Headers dump. Fix: friendlyUpdateError converts 404/401/network into Hinglish guidance; private-repo path explains both Option A (make public) and Option B (UPDATE_TOKEN fine-grained PAT). resolveFeed enables private feed whenever token is set and warns via electron-log when repo is private with no token. CI workflow writes repoPrivate from github.event.repository.private and emits ::warning if private+no secret.
